title: Susan McCasland accepted a calendar invite for a DeLonge-Podesta meeting

tellings.quote: a calendar notification shows that Susan herself accepted a Google calendar invite for something called a Dong Podesta meeting.

plain: Michels says a calendar notification shows that Susan McCasland, of the family of the Air Force general McCasland, accepted a Google calendar invite for what it called a "DeLonge Podesta meeting", meaning a meeting between the musician and UFO campaigner Tom DeLonge and the political adviser John Podesta. He points to it in the Podesta emails, the private emails WikiLeaks published in 2016, as a sign that the McCasland household was directly involved in DeLonge's UFO contacts with Washington insiders around 2015 and 2016.
